A lot of people are watching TV. You're probably not the fastest person on the planet, so somebody has googled that before you. In fact a lot of people have probably googled that exact thing in the seconds immediately preceding your decision to start typing it.

This information about which devices belong to whom is immensely valuable to advertisers hoping to target ads specifically to you.
